biography.plain_text: Jim Holmgren is an American construction entrepreneur who founded Northland Constructors in Duluth in 1970. He developed the excavating business into a regional heavy-civil contractor spanning earthwork, utilities, concrete, aggregates and paving. Holmgren also built marine-construction and port-terminal interests, extending the group's industrial reach around the western Lake Superior region.

long_biography.plain_text:
Jim Holmgren started an excavating company in Duluth in 1970 and broadened it into a contractor able to execute several stages of complex civil projects. Northland Constructors combined earthmoving and utility work with concrete, aggregate production, asphalt paving, bridge work and demolition, building a regional operation across northern Minnesota and Wisconsin.

Holmgren also extended the business toward the waterfront. He served as president of an industrial pier handling asphalt, concrete and limestone, then acquired the assets of a local dredging contractor to form Marine Tech in the mid-1990s. He sold that marine-construction company to its later president six years later. The main construction business continued to expand before being acquired by APi Group in 2016, marking the end of its founder-led period.
